title: Primary stripe specimen
slide_intent: Show how color and irregular edges can suggest a familiar food structure without drawing the whole product.
strategic_value: The layered orange, green, red, cream and brown bands can extend Burger King’s food associations into an abstract surface.
demonstration: Broad uneven horizontal color bands span the page, with thin cream and green layers separating red from a large brown band and orange above and below.
practical_value: Inspect the stripe silhouette and unequal band widths before comparing its labeled construction on the next page.

content_islands.name: Layered bands
content_islands.spec: Run irregular horizontal orange, green, red, cream and brown bands across the entire field.

content_islands.name: Running information
content_islands.spec: Keep the small header and footer over the specimen without introducing explanatory labels.

reference_purposes.Expression: The full-page specimen shows the layered, uneven stripe artwork without numeric construction rules.
